jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
About Innovas

At Innovas, we are transforming the way government innovates by delivering the mechanisms that turn ideas into action. We bring together the right people, processes, and technologies to accelerate progress where it matters most.

With a focus on impact over bureaucracy, collaboration over silos, and solutions over status quo, we we're built to act. Our team is made up of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and experts who thrive on tackling meaningful challenges and delivering results. At Innovas, every role contributes to something bigger. Whether you’re supporting technology acquisition, improving processes, or enabling collaboration across organizations, your work helps move critical missions forward.

Join Innovas and help shape the future of government innovation.

Why Work At Innovas

Work on problems that matter.

At Innovas, your work directly supports innovation that shapes our nation’s future and delivers solutions with real-world impact.

Be part of something built differently.

Our teams are empowered to focus on solving problems, creating value, and exceeding expectations.

Bring ideas to life.

Work alongside passionate problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and turning possibilities into progress.

Grow alongside a team of experts.

Our people bring diverse experiences from government, military, industry, technology, and entrepreneurship.

Job Description

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) sets and leads the technology strategy that powers the next generation of government innovation. This is an opportunity to build technology capabilities, products, and platforms that remove barriers between innovative ideas and critical solutions that support our clients' missions.

As Innovas grows, the CTO will advance the current internal technology environment while developing market changing external products, platforms, and capabilities that shape its future. The CTO provides executive leadership across enterprise applications, product development & engineering, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity & internal IT, infrastructure, data strategy, and systems integration. Working closely with executive leadership and business stakeholders, this role develops technology capabilities that improve organizational performance, accelerate product innovation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure, scalable solutions for government customers and employees. The CTO ensures technology investments align with business strategy, protects Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), and positions the company for long-term growth.

The successful candidate is an executive builder with a demonstrated ability to lead multiple technology disciplines and attract and develop exceptional talent. They bring strong business acumen and experience managing technology investments, budgets, and resources in support of strategic priorities and profitable growth. The ideal candidate leads with accountability and a willingness to roll up their sleeves to deliver results.

Executive Technology Leadership and Strategy

Develop and execute an enterprise-wide technology strategy that supports organizational growth, operational efficiency, and long-term scalability.
Provide executive guidance on technology investments, modernization priorities, and digital transformation initiatives.
Own technology budgeting, investment planning, and resource allocation, evaluating build, buy, partner, or acquire options through cost, ROI, capacity, risk, and long-term value analysis to determine the best use of company resources.
Build, mentor, and oversee high-performing teams across all internal and external technology functions including enterprise applications, product development & engineering, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity & internal IT.
Manage relationships with technology vendors, SaaS providers, MSPs, and system integrators, and support contract evaluation, renewal strategy, licensing optimization, and cost management.
Work with executive team to strengthen cross-functional engagement and drive organization-wide adoption of technology and security practices.
Provide coaching, development, and clear expectations to ensure operational excellence and professional growth.

The CTO Is Accountable For Building And Leading The Technology Organization, Establishing Strong Functional Leadership, And Ensuring The Performance And Success Of The Following Teams And Capabilities

Product Development & AI Strategy

Partner with Product, Innovation, Growth, and business leaders to evaluate new product opportunities, determine technical feasibility and investment requirements, and move solutions from concept through deployment.
Lead software engineering, overseeing technical architecture, application development, DevOps, QA and testing, and the release and production support lifecycle.
Establish engineering standards, development practices, release management, documentation, and technology governance across all product lines.
Define and execute the company’s AI strategy, identifying opportunities to embed AI into products, enterprise platforms, and internal operations.
Establish the architecture, data, security, governance, and development standards required to deploy AI capabilities in government environments.

Enterprise Systems, Infrastructure, & Data Governance

Lead enterprise system implementations, including CRM, ERP/finance, CLM, member platforms, and program management systems.
Establish enterprise standards for system architecture, resilience, performance, and service continuity.
Oversee integration strategy using APIs, middleware, automation frameworks, and MDM principles to maintain a single source of truth.
Partner with operations on change management, system sustainability, documentation, and operational performance across all major platforms.
Build and maintain secure and scalable data environments, including an enterprise data lake, data warehouses, and reporting ecosystems.
Define and enforce data governance standards covering taxonomy, metadata, lineage, retention, and quality.
Ensure data architecture supports analytics, forecasting, reporting, and emerging AI-enabled capabilities.

Cybersecurity, Compliance & Risk Management

Lead the company’s cybersecurity program, including policy development, identity and access controls, vulnerability management, and continuous monitoring.
Ensure compliance with federal frameworks, including NIST 800-171, CUI handling, DFARS requirements, CMMC readiness, and FedRAMP-aligned controls.
Develop systems and processes to manage classified data as required.
Own technology and cybersecurity risk management in alignment with federal and contractual requirements.
Oversee incident response, audit preparation, third-party security evaluations, and remediation planning.
Serve as the primary liaison with auditors, compliance consultants, and government technology representatives.

Internal IT & Employee Support

Lead internal IT operations and employee technology support, including help desk, service delivery, Microsoft 365 administration, cloud environments, network administration, and endpoint management.
Oversee employee technology onboarding and offboarding, account provisioning, device deployment, access management, and IT ticket escalation.
Establish service standards, SLAs, escalation procedures, and support processes that ensure responsive and reliable employee technology support.
Own endpoint and device management, including configuration, security, patching, monitoring, and ongoing administration.
Oversee IT asset management and the full asset lifecycle, including procurement, inventory, assignment, maintenance, replacement, recovery, and disposition.
Ensure business continuity, disaster recovery readiness, infrastructure reliability, and long-term modernization of the employee technology environment.

Qualifications

Must be a U.S. citizen with an ability to obtain security clearance.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.

Experience And Skills

15+ years of progressive technology leadership, including experience as a CTO, CIO, or senior technology executive leading and scaling multidisciplinary technology organizations.
Proven success building technology teams and capabilities through significant organizational growth, maintaining an entrepreneurial, hands-on approach while establishing the structure required to scale.
Demonstrated ownership of enterprise technology strategy, budgets, investment priorities, workforce planning, and resource allocation.
Proven expertise evaluating and executing build, buy, partner, or acquire strategies, including technology due diligence, M&A integration, and investment analysis.
Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to connect technology investments and resource decisions to growth, profitability, customer value, and long-term enterprise value.
Demonstrable success leading the development and commercialization of complex software products and platforms, with a strong understanding of software engineering, product development, AI/ML, technical architecture, and modern development practices.
Proven ability to build and lead cross-functional technology organizations where engineering, product, business, security, and operations work together to move products and capabilities from concept through deployment.
Demonstrable success leading distributed teams and developing strong functional leaders who can scale their organizations while maintaining accountability, speed, and execution.
Proven expertise in advising executive leadership on technology strategy, emerging technologies, cybersecurity and enterprise risk, M&A, and major investment decisions.
Experience operating in government or highly regulated environments, with responsibility for CUI, cybersecurity, compliance, and technology risk strongly preferred.

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting CLM systems, CRM ecosystems (such as Salesforce), ERP/finance platforms, membership or subscription platforms, and low-code/no-code tools.
Background working with DoD agencies, federal program offices, government contract service firms, or entities operating under Other Transaction Authority (OTA) environments.
Familiarity with professional services or consulting environments serving U.S. Government clients.
Advanced certifications such as PMP, ITIL, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age (40 or older), disability, or genetic information.

What We Offer

We strive to be one of the best places to work in America. We offer competitive salaries and benefits that include:

jobs.description:
The VP, Technology & AI (T&AI)
is a newly created leadership position at Woodruff. We’re looking for a transparent, innovative and results-driven leader with a diverse background to lead our technology vision and delivery capabilities within our T&AI core strength.

This role is responsible for advancing how technology, with an emphasis on AI, enhances both client outcomes and agency operations. By combining deep technical expertise with a forward-looking perspective on emerging technologies, this role ensures the agency remains at the forefront of digital experience development, automation, integration, quality assurance and AI-driven innovation.

This leader plays a key role in evaluating and implementing AI initiatives that improve efficiency, expand service offerings and create competitive advantage. The ideal candidate will partner closely with other agency leadership and cross-functional teams to shape future capabilities, establish best practices and foster a culture of innovation and continuous learning.

The VP of technology & AI will be a member of Woodruff’s leadership team, working closely with them to drive forward-thinking strategies and impactful technology solutions in order to achieve our goals and build a strong business and culture of trust. This person will also be responsible for building, mentoring and developing high-performing technology teams, ensuring technology strengths continue to evolve and drive long-term agency success.

This person must be located in the Kansas City or Columbia, MO, area.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Technology & AI Leadership

Define and lead the agency's technology and AI vision and roadmap, ensuring investments align with client needs and future growth opportunities
Establish and champion the agency's AI strategy, identifying where and how AI can create value across internal operations, client work, workflows and service offerings
Lead a disciplined approach to AI adoption by focusing investments in high-impact opportunities with clear outcomes
Pilot and implement emerging technologies, AI platforms and other technical solutions that improve efficiency, enhance capabilities and create competitive advantage
Develop and oversee AI governance, policies and best practices to ensure responsible, effective and secure adoption across the organization
Define the agency's vision for search in the AI era by integrating SEO, AI optimization (AIO), structured data and generative search best practices into client strategies while mentoring teams on emerging technologies and evolving search behavior
Serve as the agency's technology and AI thought leader, staying ahead of emerging technologies, evolving AI legislation, regulatory requirements and industry best practices while educating teams, guiding responsible AI adoption and driving the implementation of innovative tools and approaches that deliver measurable business value
Oversee our internal technology needs and external IT services, collaborating with our operations team.

Technical Strategy & Executional Leadership

Advise internal teams and clients on technology and AI opportunities, helping shape strategies that improve business outcomes, customer experiences and operational effectiveness
Alongside our technical architect, provide deep technical expertise and practical guidance to ensure the successful execution of complex digital and technology initiatives
Alongside our technical architect, consult on the development, implementation, QA and maintenance of websites, digital platforms, applications, marketing technology solutions and integrated technology ecosystems
Roll up your sleeves to support critical initiatives, using hands-on execution as a vehicle for coaching, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Cross-Function Collaboration

Partner with agency leadership and cross-functional teams to assess and evolve technology and AI capabilities that support agency growth
Foster interconnected ways of working across core strengths, ensuring technology and AI considerations are integrated throughout project life cycles
Establish and improve documentation standards, workflows and operational processes that strengthen collaboration across disciplines and create greater visibility into how systems, tools, teams and technologies work together
Support business development, scoping and estimation efforts by providing technical expertise and strategic guidance during planning and proposal development.

Team Development

Build, mentor and develop high-performing technology teams while cultivating a culture of innovation and continuous learning
Continuously assess the performance, structure and maturity of the Technology & AI core strength, making recommendations that strengthen capabilities, improve delivery and support long-term agency success.

Departmental responsibilities, including working with your direct report on policy enforcements, OOO requests and adhering to hiring criteria
Regular communication, including one-on-ones, conflict resolution, philosophy guidance and ongoing coaching and mentoring
Employee enrichment, including working with your direct report on goal setting, timely performance reviews and ongoing feedback.

Knowledge and Skills:

Demonstrated success leading technology and AI strategy within an agency, consulting firm or complex marketing organization
Deep understanding of web technologies, marketing technology ecosystems systems integration and digital platforms
Experience evaluating and implementing AI technologies that drive measurable business outcomes
Strong understanding of SEO, AI optimization (AIO), generative search and the evolving search landscape
Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into practical business solutions
Experience leading cross-functional teams and mentoring technical professionals
Working knowledge of AI governance, privacy, security and the evolving regulatory landscape
Working knowledge of current web technologies
Working knowledge of CMS platforms such as WordPress, Drupal and/or Hubspot
Working knowledge of email marketing or CRM platforms such as SalesForce and/or Campaign Monitor
An entrepreneurial, forward-thinking spirit
Happy to build relationships and trust, connect the dots, find a better way to solve existing problems
Ability to identify simpler ways to solve problems
Ability to embrace our core value of freedom — to be bold, to experiment, to challenge, to act and to celebrate — and a history of doing so throughout their career.

Leader Behaviors:

Open-minded and active listener
Continually grows people and business
Truthful and transparent
Decisive and accountable
Forward-thinking
Proactive and communicates in a positive manner

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.

Position Overview:

Do you excel at bringing clarity from ambiguity? We are building out a Business Architecture practice to guide transformational IT improvements supporting Citi's global Finance functions. Partner with data architects to influence data architecture — including Finance-wide data vision, governance, and platform direction — in support of the business architecture
Align strategic technical investments to the target state architecture across all Finance technology partners, governing and justifying any deviations
Develop and evangelize business architecture principles guaranteeing straight-through processing and the timeliness, completeness, and accuracy of financial reporting
Champion Citi architecture principles and standards, counselling engineering teams on application in deliverables
Provide early-stage architecture input to shape Book of Work scope and sequencing, and play a leading role in the Finance Tech Design Authority
Own and govern Permit to Design / Permit to Build processes, and produce architecture strategy papers and executive investment narratives for senior Finance and Technology leadership
Identify, evaluate, and prioritize opportunities to embed AI, ML, and GenAI within Finance processes, defining governance and control frameworks
Lead capability mapping, maturity assessments, and heat maps informing investment prioritization; maintain oversight of the centralized architecture knowledge repository
Champion continuous improvement of the business architecture discipline — driving best practices, tooling, and training
Owns reference data to support consistent reporting structure
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency

Finance Domain & Transformation Experience:

Deep knowledge of FP&A (budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, close), Treasury (cash, liquidity, FX, intercompany), and Management Reporting (aggregation, allocation, multi-dimensional reporting) processes and their architectural implications
Proven experience leading Finance transformation programs, with the ability to define target architectures and guide delivery teams through complex change including ERP migrations, ledger consolidations, and reporting modernization
Deep familiarity with ERP platforms (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Financials), Performance Management tools (e.g., Anaplan, OneStream, SAP BPC, Oracle EPM), and cube technologies (e.g., Essbase, TM1)
Credible and influential with senior Finance SMEs, CDO and CIO stakeholders, and delivery leaders on system design, data strategy, and process change

Qualifications:

10+ years in an engineering and/or architecture capacity supporting Finance or related business functions, ideally in Financial Services
Proven track record delivering cross-functional business process improvement and enterprise-wide architecture change
Experienced leading virtual teams in matrix environments; self-motivated and able to own initiatives end-to-end
Outstanding communication skills enabling influence at all levels, from technical developers to the most senior executive leaders
Methodical, detail-oriented, with deep familiarity with modern enterprise information architecture practices
AI Domain Knowledge: Conceptual understanding of AI/ML, GenAI, and agentic automation and their applicability to Finance use cases including anomaly detection, forecasting, and regulatory reporting
AI Personal Productivity: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively, including prompt engineering, iterative refinement, and critical evaluation of AI-generated content

Foster interconnected ways of working across core strengths, ensuring technology and AI considerations are integrated throughout project life cycles
Establish and improve documentation standards, workflows and operational processes that strengthen collaboration across disciplines and create greater visibility into how systems, tools, teams and technologies work together
Support business development, scoping and estimation efforts by providing technical expertise and strategic guidance during planning and proposal development.

Build, mentor and develop high-performing technology teams while cultivating a culture of innovation and continuous learning
Continuously assess the performance, structure and maturity of the Technology & AI core strength, making recommendations that strengthen capabilities, improve delivery and support long-term agency success.

Employee enrichment, including working with your direct report on goal setting, timely performance reviews and ongoing feedback.

Experience evaluating and implementing AI technologies that drive measurable business outcomes

Ability to embrace our core value of freedom — to be bold, to experiment, to challenge, to act and to celebrate — and a history of doing so throughout their career.

Continually grows people and business
